title: Getting around
summary: Ask the way, buy a ticket

sentences.en: Excuse me, where is the train station?
sentences.es: Perdone, ¿dónde está la estación de tren?
sentences.pt: Desculpe, onde fica a estação de comboios?

sentences.en: Turn left at the next street.
sentences.es: Gire a la izquierda en la próxima calle.
sentences.pt: Vire à esquerda na próxima rua.

sentences.en: A ticket to the city centre, please.
sentences.es: Un billete al centro, por favor.
sentences.pt: Um bilhete para o centro, por favor.

sentences.en: What time does the bus leave?
sentences.pt: A que horas parte o autocarro?

passages.text: Atención, por favor. El tren con destino a Valencia, que tenía prevista su salida a las diez y cuarto, saldrá con veinte minutos de retraso por la vía cuatro. Disculpen las molestias.
passages.en: Attention, please. The train to Valencia, scheduled to leave at quarter past ten, will depart twenty minutes late from platform four. We apologise for the inconvenience.
passages.question: What is happening with the Valencia train?
passages.answer: It leaves twenty minutes late, from platform four.
wrong: It is cancelled. Passengers should take a bus.
It leaves on time from platform twenty.
It now leaves from a different station.

passages.text: Atenção, por favor. O comboio com destino ao Porto, com partida prevista para as dez e um quarto, vai sair com vinte minutos de atraso da linha quatro. Pedimos desculpa pelo incómodo.
passages.en: Attention, please. The train to Porto, scheduled to leave at quarter past ten, will depart twenty minutes late from platform four. We apologise for the inconvenience.
passages.question: What is happening with the Porto train?
passages.answer: It leaves twenty minutes late, from platform four.
wrong: It is cancelled. Passengers should take a bus.
It leaves on time from platform twenty.
It now leaves from a different station.
